verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party docs say it was "designed from the ground up with self-hosting in mind". It can run on any OS with a Docker CLI, on Kubernetes via an official Helm chart, or through one-click marketplace installs, and you can migrate between Cloud and self-hosted. Community users independently report self-installing it easily and praise the self-hosting and production guides. Missing for 10: documentation on scaling a self-hosted instance (a user reported finding none) and explicit evidence that self-hosted has feature parity with Cloud.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Appwrite was designed from the ground up with self-hosting in mind. You can install and run Appwrite on any operating system that can run a Docker CLI.
or on your own Kubernetes cluster with the official Helm chart.
You can also migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted.
Use a one-click deployment - Choose from marketplace installations for instant setup
